items.followUp: Write any two advantages of Star Topology.

rubric.why: Token passing provides orderly access to the ring and helps prevent data collisions.
rubric.description: States an advantage related to orderly transmission or avoiding collisions.
rubric.how: Award for a valid point such as token passing or collision prevention.

rubric.why: Ring topology also gives computers a fair chance to transmit or can make faults easier to locate.
rubric.description: States a second valid advantage of ring topology.
rubric.how: Award for a distinct valid point, such as equal access, good performance under heavy traffic, or easier fault location.

modelAnswer: Token passing allows data to travel in an orderly manner and helps prevent collisions.
Each computer gets an equal opportunity to transmit data.
